[b][size=5]Description[/size][/b]
In Stardew Valley co-op, only the host's character can be played in single-player mode. This mod lets you swap which character holds the host slot before loading a save — so you can experience the game from any co-op farmer's perspective.
如果主持存档的朋友不再登录星露谷，但你对之前打拼的存档仍有留恋，可以用这个mod把存档的房主换成你的角色，继续玩下去，保留珍贵的游戏回忆。


[b]This mod fits if you:[/b]
[list]
[*]Want to keep the original host's full home and welcome them back anytime.[/*]
[*]Refuse to give up your own decorated house.[/*]
[*]Have a heavily modded save — editing XML risks breaking mod data.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]How to use[/b]
[list=1]
[*]If the save isn't on your computer yet, copy the save folder from the host's computer first (%AppData%\StardewValley\Saves\<save_folder>). [/*]
[*]After loading your save, press [ (open bracket) while in-game to open the Host Switcher menu. [/*]
[*]Select the character you want to play as next session and confirm. [/*]
[*]Exit to the title screen and reload — you'll now be playing as that character. [/*]
[*]Remember to sleep and save the game after switching![/*]
[/list][b]Features
[/b]
[list]
[*]Each farmer stays in their original home — no forced relocation. [/*]
[*]The main farmhouse renders correctly for its actual resident: spouse room, extension rooms, and NPC decorations all display properly. [/*]
[*]Children remain in the correct house.[/*]
[*]In multiplayer, the spouse NPC, mail, and Return Scepter point to the actual resident's farmhouse.[/*]
[*]Farm-global progress (Community Center / Joja unlocks, Ginger Island boat, farm cave choice) is preserved after a swap. [/*]
[*]Your save is backed up automatically before the first swap. Restore anytime with hs_restore_original <save_folder> from the SMAPI console on the title screen.[/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Console commands[/b]
[list]
[*]hs_set_next_host <save> <farmer> — Queue a swap (alternative to the [ menu) [/*]
[*]hs_cancel_swap — Cancel the pending swap hs_status — Show pending swap status [/*]
[*]hs_inspect [save] — Show host and farmhand info from a save file (no argument: list all saves) [/*]
[*]hs_restore_original <save> — Restore save to its original pre-mod state [/*]
[*]hs_restore_savegameinfo <save> — Restore the save list display if it looks wrong [/*]
[*]hs_set_key <name> — Change the menu key [/*]
[*]hs_detect_key — Press any key to see its name (use before hs_set_key) [/*]
[/list][line]
[b]Known limitations
[/b]
[list]
[*]Same mod version required for all players in multiplayer. [/*]
[*]The original host needs a cabin to rejoin as farmhand. [/*]
[*]Uninstalling breaks the main farmhouse rendering. [/*]
[/list][b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]Stardew Valley 1.6.15 or later[/*]
[/list][line]
[size=4][b]Changelog[/b][/size]

[b]Version 2.0.0 [/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed: the previous runtime patch could make Joja-route saves show the Minecart as damaged. The patch has been removed.[/*]
[*]Community Center unlocks after a host swap (Minecarts, Quarry bridge, skills-page stars) no longer rely on that patch. Missing Community Center flags are now corrected when the host loads a previously swapped save, based on the actual Community Center state or flags other players already have. Flags are only added, never removed, and the correction is saved into the save file. Saves that were never swapped are not touched. [/*]
[*]Fixed: the bus to the Desert could stay out of service after a host swap.[/*]
[/list][b]Version 1.3.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed Community Center content sometimes staying locked after a host swap.[/*]
[*]Improved reliability of a few other one-time flag transfers during swaps.[/*]
[/list][b]Version 1.2.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed an occasional issue where Community Center stars could show as incomplete after a host swap.[/*]
[*]Fixed a rare case where the player character could become uncontrollable after a swap following a farmhouse upgrade.[/*]
[*]Added ‘hs_set_key’ / ‘hs_detect_key’ to remap the menu key (useful for non-[ keyboards and Android).[/*]
[*]Penny's room redecoration now works correctly for the actual resident.[/*]
[/list][b]Version 1.1.0[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed multiplayer join errors for the original host. [/*]
[*]Added UpdateKeys for automatic update notifications.[/*]
[/list][line]
